g1.flow: Both say you cannot cause Allāh failure and have no protector or helper. Al-ʿAnkabūt adds wa lā fis-samāʾ (nor in the heaven), after 'He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills'. Ash-Shūrā stops at fil-arḍ (upon the earth), after disaster coming from what your hands earned, then ships in the sea. Hook: Ash-Shūrā's version stays on the earth, and its next ayah moves to the sea.

cues.29:22: Al-ʿAnkabūt: adds wa lā fis-samāʾ; after He punishes or shows mercy to whom He wills.
cues.42:31: Ash-Shūrā: earth only, no heaven; after disaster for what your hands earned; next, ships like mountains.
